coverLetter.subject: Work-Study Application – Digital Marketing & Growth (4 days company / 1 day school)
coverLetter.paragraph:
Attentive to your company's digital innovations and growth trajectory, I am eager to propose my candidacy as a work-study candidate to actively contribute to your digital expansion and international visibility.

Driven by an entrepreneurial and self-taught mindset, I combine creative intuition with technical execution. This approach has enabled me to independently build high-impact digital products: scaling self-published mobile applications to over 2M+ cumulative downloads, and developing a health information database for people living with irritable bowel syndrome.

Operationally, I bring proven execution across organic search (SEO, ASO, GEO), CMS management (WordPress), and performance analytics (GA4). I also leverage AI on a daily basis to build custom automations that streamline operations, while maintaining strict critical judgment over outputs. Fully fluent in English (C2 level), French, and Arabic, with a solid grasp of international and African markets, I navigate multicultural environments with ease.

Currently admitted to the Digital Communication, Social Media and Community Management program at ISCOM on a 4-day company / 1-day school schedule, I am eager to channel this autonomy and problem-solving drive into your team's ambitions.
coverLetter.closing: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your upcoming goals during an interview.
